skill.name: higgsfield-product-photoshoot
skill.description: Generate product photos, lifestyle scenes, hero banners, social ad packs, virtual model try-ons, and restyled product images with Higgsfield.
skill.summary: Create guided product photoshoot images through the Higgsfield CLI.
skill.author: higgsfield-ai

security_audit.summary: Most static detections are false positives from Markdown code spans for modes, options, and sample output. The real issues are the curl-to-shell installer, Bash CLI execution, and local image auto-upload to an external backend. No prompt injection attempt was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: Remote installer executes from a pipe to shell.
remediation.suggestion: Use a pinned package install, checksum verification, and explicit user confirmation before any install command runs.

remediation.issue: CLI commands run through Bash with user-supplied prompt and image paths.
remediation.suggestion: Validate mode, count, aspect ratio, and image paths before invoking Bash, and quote every argument.

remediation.issue: Local image paths are auto-uploaded to an external service.
remediation.suggestion: Ask users to confirm each file upload and warn that product images leave the local machine.

remediation.issue: Network and account requirements are easy to miss.
remediation.suggestion: Document that the skill requires Higgsfield authentication and sends data to Higgsfield services.

content.value_statement: Product teams need campaign images in many formats without writing complex image prompts. This skill guides choices, calls Higgsfield, and returns finished image URLs.
actual_capabilities: Selects a photoshoot mode for studio, lifestyle, banner, carousel, ad, model, concept, or restyle work.
Asks three or four labeled questions when product, style, count, or channel details are missing.
Runs the Higgsfield product-photoshoot workflow with mode, prompt, image, count, and aspect ratio inputs.
Accepts local image paths or upload IDs as product references.
Uses backend prompt enhancement instead of writing the final image prompt directly.
Returns image URLs and brief failure status messages.
limitations: Requires the Higgsfield CLI and an authenticated Higgsfield account.
Can upload local product images and prompt details to Higgsfield services.
Does not support no-product text-to-image, video avatars, marketplace cards, or Soul Character training.
Does not expose internal job IDs or backend-enhanced prompts to the user.

use_cases.title: Launch Store Product Images
use_cases.description: Create clean studio and lifestyle images for product detail pages and launch collections.

use_cases.title: Build Paid Social Variants
use_cases.description: Generate coordinated static ad creatives for Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, or Google campaigns.

use_cases.title: Explore Seasonal Brand Looks
use_cases.description: Restyle existing product shots for seasonal campaigns while preserving the main product subject.

prompt_templates.title: Simple Studio Shot
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with one product image.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create three clean studio product photos for this uploaded bottle. Use a white background, soft shadows, and Shopify square format.

prompt_templates.title: Lifestyle Product Scene
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a lifestyle scene for this coffee bag on a sunlit kitchen counter. Make three images for Instagram feed use.

prompt_templates.title: Ad Creative Pack
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a five-slide paid social ad creative pack for this skincare product. Highlight hydration, premium packaging, and calm colors.

prompt_templates.title: Controlled Restyle
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request using an existing product image.
prompt_templates.prompt: Restyle this existing product image for a winter campaign. Preserve the label, package shape, and product placement.

output_examples.input: An ecommerce manager uploads a serum bottle photo and asks for three Shopify-ready studio images.
output_examples.output: The skill asks for count, mood, use channel, and brand colors, then returns image URLs when the job completes.

output_examples.input: A marketer asks for a paid social pack for a snack brand using an uploaded package image.
output_examples.output: The skill selects the ad creative pack mode and returns a coordinated set of image URLs for campaign testing.

output_examples.input: A designer uploads an existing candle image and asks for a Christmas version.
output_examples.output: The skill uses restyle mode, preserves the candle, and returns image URLs with the requested seasonal look.

best_practices: Upload a clear product image when label accuracy and packaging fidelity matter.
State the use channel, count, and mood before generation to reduce follow-up questions.
Confirm any local image upload before sending product assets to an external service.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for raw text-to-image requests without a product or brand context.
Do not bypass the product-photoshoot workflow with a direct image model command.
Do not ask for more than four interview questions before starting the job.

faq.question: Does this require a Higgsfield account?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill requires the Higgsfield CLI and an authenticated Higgsfield account.

faq.question: Does the skill write the final image prompt?
faq.answer: No. It sends a short intent description to Higgsfield, and the backend builds the final prompt.

faq.question: Can I use a local product image?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill accepts a local image path or upload ID, then Higgsfield uploads the asset.

faq.question: What image types can it create?
faq.answer: It supports studio shots, lifestyle scenes, closeups, pins, banners, carousels, ad packs, model try-ons, concepts, and restyles.

faq.question: Does it create product video?
faq.answer: No. It creates still product images. Use a related Higgsfield generation skill for video or avatar workflows.

faq.question: Can I choose the aspect ratio?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill uses mode defaults unless you request a supported aspect ratio.
